text.p: Monsanto Co said Monday it reduced its stake in Southwall Technologies Inc to the equivalent of 386,579 common shares or 5.98 percent of the total oustanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the St. Louis, Mo.,-based agricultural and chemical products maker said it sold 84,421 shares of Southwall between September 26 and October 3. The filing did not specify how much Monsanto received for the shares sold.
In addition, Monsanto said it received 33,528 shares from Southwall as payment of interest of a convertible note of Southwall that it holds.
Southwall is a Palo Alto, Calif.,-based marker of thin film coatings used in making commerical, defense and electronic products.
